Explore Our Services Get in Touch About WLC Ltd A lifetime in transport, packed into a consultancy. WLC Ltd is fronted by Gareth Webb, previous director of the family-owned European removals specialists Webbs International Removals Ltd and Webbs International Removals SL. In late 2025, the family made the decision to close down the companies due to founder Mr William Webb suffering from health issues and bowing out at the top of the game for corporate and domestic moving to the Balearic Islands. William Webb is now enjoying a well-earned retirement and recovery back in the UK, Gareth Webb is continuing a path in the sector. Gareth has been in and around the removals industry from five years old, inevitably being sacked during the early days but learning huge life lessons leading into what was a 29-year apprenticeship.
